name: Ayumi Tanaka
bio:
Ayumi Tanaka's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport finance began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in economics from Kyoto University, she initially worked in corporate banking. However, a chance encounter with a race team owner at a charity event sparked her interest. Intrigued by the complexities of motorsport finance – the constant need for precise budgeting, strategic investment in technology, and navigating the ever-shifting landscape of sponsorship deals – she made a career pivot. 

Ayumi joined Richard Childress Racing five years ago, quickly proving herself to be a highly competent and experienced finance controller. Her approach is meticulous and data-driven, always seeking innovative ways to optimize financial performance. She believes in fostering open communication between the finance department and other teams, ensuring that everyone understands the financial implications of their decisions. Ayumi's calm demeanor and ability to remain composed under pressure make her an invaluable asset, especially during tense race weekends when budgets are stretched and deadlines loom. Her commitment to accuracy and her ability to think strategically set her apart in a demanding field.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers and a side part.
physical.description: Ayumi is of average height with a slender build, often seen wearing professional attire.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations.
Prefers to work in complete silence, even wearing noise-canceling headphones.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on her desk.
